disable_schedule_failed.message: Failed to disable the Neato cleaning schedule.

enable_schedule_failed.message: Failed to enable the Neato cleaning schedule.

return_to_base_failed.message: Failed to send the vacuum back to its dock.

custom_cleaning.description: Starts a custom cleaning of your house.

category.description: Whether to use a persistent map or not for cleaning (i.e. No go lines): 2 for no map, 4 for map. Default to using map if not set (and fallback to no map if no map is found).
category.name: Use cleaning map

mode.description: Sets the cleaning mode: 1 for eco and 2 for turbo. Defaults to turbo if not set.
mode.name: Cleaning mode

navigation.description: Sets the navigation mode: 1 for normal, 2 for extra care, 3 for deep. Defaults to normal if not set.
navigation.name: Navigation mode

zone.description: Name of the zone to clean (only supported on the Botvac D7). Defaults to no zone i.e. complete house cleanup.
zone.name: Zone
